newsitem.title: INDONESIA: RESEARCH ALERT - Buy Kalbe --Asia Equity.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Buy Kalbe --Asia Equity.

text.p: Asia Equity Indonesia has recommended a "buy" on pharmaceutical firm Kalbe Farma, based on its 1997 earnings prospects and expected strong demand after recent distribution problems.

The brokerage's report, received on Thursday, said Kalbe's current price earnings ratio (PER) of 12.8 times was cheap, based on a forecast of 16 percent earnings growth in 1997. The report did not give precise figures.
"A re-rating to a PER of just 16 times 1997 earnings would mean a price appreciation to 6,300 rupiah or 46 percent," Asia Equity said.
It added that inventory problems encountered by Kalbe Farma's main distributor, Enseval, were close to being resolved.
"Inventory days and receivable days at Enseval showed good improvement," the report noted. "We believe that by next year, Kalbe Farma and Enseval will have returned to a more normal situation."
Kalbe was up 400 rupiah at 4,900 on turnover of 896,000 shares at 0900 GMT on the Jakarta stock market on Thursday. Enseval was up 150 rupiah to 1,275 on volume of 1.7 million shares.
